title: Planar tetracoordinate oxygen stabilized within triel–chalcogen dicationic frameworks

Nine D4h dicationic clusters O©X4E42+ (X = Al, Ga, In; E = S, Se, Te) are identified as global minima featuring planar tetracoordinate oxygen stabilized by electrostatic embedding within a rigid triel–chalcogen scaffold.
